description: This file contains performance tests scripts for Git repository analysis, including setup procedures, performance benchmarks for Git commands, and some testing utility commands.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Runs performance tests on large repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing provided commands.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a specific performance benchmark with a description.

methods.name: test-tool-reach-get-branch-base-for-tip
methods.description: Retrieves the base commit for a given branch or tag in the test-tool reachability context.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script definition.
